_note: Cursor project MCP configuration. This .cursor/mcp.json file is the project-scoped source of truth for Cursor. Keep tool usage procedures in skills, invariants in rules, and deterministic checks in hooks/scripts. Prefer least-privilege local-first retrieval before broad semantic expansion.

filesystem._comment: Filesystem MCP scope is locked to repo root only. Keep writes inside approved project territories and do not reference editor-specific legacy paths.
filesystem._startup: Launcher: node .cursor/scripts/filesystem_mcp_launcher.js resolves the server script via npm prefix -g at runtime, proxies stdio explicitly, waits for readiness on stderr, and enforces a startup watchdog.
filesystem._shadow_disable: 2026-05-02 Author-Gate F4 verdict (plan token-burn-followup-f8c2d1, ADR-095): shadow-disabled for 30 days. Schema cost 3,056 tokens / 14 tools — full native substitutes available (read_file, write_to_file, edit, list_dir, find_by_name). Re-enable: set disabled=false. Retire after 30 days if turn_budget.jsonl shows 0 mcp4_* tool calls.

vector_db._tuning_note: Runtime defaults (batch sizes, timeouts) live in tools/retrieval/vector_config.py. Only non-default overrides and operational required-vars (offline mode, download policy, path, model) are pinned here. Full history of pruned vars: 2026-04-22 MCP-5.

task_manager._shadow_disable: 2026-05-02 Author-Gate F4 verdict (plan token-burn-followup-f8c2d1, ADR-095): shadow-disabled for 30 days. Schema cost 2,524 tokens / 4 tools (worst per-tool ratio at 631/tool). Substitute: structured-reasoning skill (SR_PLAN/SR_EXECUTE) covers most multi-step workflow needs. Re-enable: set disabled=false. Retire after 30 days if turn_budget.jsonl shows 0 mcp11_* tool calls.

notion._auth: Requires NOTION_TOKEN set as a Windows OS environment variable (setx NOTION_TOKEN secret_...). The env block below passes it explicitly to the npx subprocess — do not rely on implicit inheritance. Create token at https://www.notion.so/my-integrations (Internal integration). pre_mcp_gate blocks with an actionable message when the variable is absent.

tavily._auth: Requires TAVILY_API_KEY set as a Windows OS environment variable (setx TAVILY_API_KEY tvly-...). Create key at https://app.tavily.com/home. Free tier: 1000 credits/month. pre_mcp_gate blocks with an actionable message when the variable is absent — same pattern as Notion. Package: https://github.com/tavily-ai/tavily-mcp.

context7._note: Upstash Context7 MCP — up-to-date, versioned official library documentation on demand (chromadb, FastMCP, sentence-transformers, playwright, pytorch, etc.). No API key required on free tier. CONTEXT7_API_KEY (optional) at https://context7.com/dashboard raises rate limits. Package: https://github.com/upstash/context7.

playwright._note: Official Microsoft Playwright MCP (@playwright/mcp). Thin npx wrapper, no custom server file. Browser session output lands in repo-root .playwright-mcp/ which should be gitignored.

_bootstrap_env: Set AGENTIC_REPO_ROOT to your local repo root and GITKRAKEN_GK_PATH to the GitKraken CLI executable. Keep tokens in OS env vars; Cursor supports project-scoped MCP configuration through .cursor/mcp.json.
